cohort: 4956 infants born at 24-29 weeks gestational age in Switzerland from 2002-2014 with G3-IVH and/or PVHI
finding: From 2002-2014, there was no change in the rates of mortality or NDI in very preterm born infants with major brain lesions (G3-IVH and PVHI), despite a decrease in mean gestational age at birth.
